english.quote: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.
Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.
Let them praise the name of the Lord: for he commanded, and they were created.
He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.
And God said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
And God called the firmament Heaven. And the evening and the morning were the second day.

sides.label: A
sides.quote: ye waters that be above the heavens

overlap.title: A solid sky dome?
overlap.summary: A literal solid dome holding back an upper sea conflicts with atmospheric science. Whether “firmament” means that dome is an interpretive question.
overlap.scope: “Snowglobe Earth” is a modern analogy for the dome interpretation, not a phrase or complete model stated in this verse. Verse 6 alone does not establish a flat Earth. The physical dome model disagrees with science; the lexical and literary interpretation remains disputed. This is our conditional assessment, not a NASA judgment on scripture.
